description: Abstract class implementing connection lifecycle management for Hono client factories, including connection handling, listeners, and disconnect logic.

classes.name: AbstractHonoClientFactory
classes.description: An abstract base class for creating client factories that manage Hono connections, providing connection lifecycle methods and listener management.

methods.name: addDisconnectListener
methods.description: Adds a disconnect listener to the Hono connection.

methods.name: addReconnectListener
methods.description: Adds a reconnect listener to the Hono connection.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiates connection to the Hono service.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the client is currently connected.

methods.name: isConnected (with timeout)
methods.description: Checks connection status with a timeout for ongoing connection attempts.

methods.name: getDefaultConnectionCheckTimeout
methods.description: Returns the default timeout for connection checks based on client configuration.

methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.description: Hook method called when the connection is lost; meant to be overridden by subclasses.
